name: governor_scan
description: Wren's MANAGEMENT DETECTION engine. Scans the whole live tower and returns a RANKED agenda of concrete things that need doing right now: cold floors (idle >24h needing a wake), skeleton floor cards (needing fit-out), loud unmet worker needs (many workers reporting the same thing), blocked council tasks, and stalled in-progress tasks (SLA drift). Each finding carries a suggested_task_title and an already_on_board flag (de-duped against the current council board). Use this to DECIDE what management tasks to create: pick the top findings where already_on_board=false and create a real council task for each via wren_create_council_task. This is how Wren governs from real state instead of guessing.
